events.title: The Small Updates Continue
events.summary: Few more things I got fixed that I want to be fixed in the demo for everyone. Fixed issue where screen wasn't fading between scenes Fixed issue where game could become stuck on death. Fixed issue where fire rate time wasn't being calculated properly I can't promise more of these won't pop up. I love fixed things, sorry.

events.title: Another Small Update
events.summary: Hey Gang, Wanted to push another quick update to address some things that popped up. Fixed issue where blood was compounding and causing lag spikes.Updated gib system to be more performantAdded Restart button to pause menu incase players get stuck for whatever reason. I'll keep an eye on things and keep pushing hotfixes as I can. Thanks for playing!

events.title: One Little Update
events.summary: Had a few things I wanted to get taken care of before the fest started. Further optimization to blood systemFixed issue where instant death power up used old blood systemFixed visibility issue with new bandage Changed scaling on some sprites to better keep visual style. Fixed issue where player would clip into floor when hurtIncreased blood sprays across all damage.

events.title: Demo Patch 02
events.summary: Another Patch! Whoo! Saw some comments about some things so I thought I'd try to clean them up a smidge. Upgraded to Godot 4.6 (Better Performance hopefully)Upgraded the max FPS to 1000 Added support for D pad movement on controllers Added better navigation of options menu with controller I'll keep updating small things as I can in preparation for the big update next month. Thanks for the Support!

events.title: Demo Patch 01
events.summary: Wanted to push a small patch to address some issues and add some things to help with progress.Level Progress is now saved. If you make it past level 1, that game will save that progress as well as the upgrade you have chosen so beating the demo doesn't have to be in a single run. Just hit "Continue" next time you boot the game. Selecting "New Game" will wipe your previous progress and reset and stats gained.Adjusted the size of the collision hit-box for dashing for hopefully better consistency.

events.title: DEMO IS LIVE!
events.summary: I know it's kinda random, and honestly it is! The more I've read, the more people suggest to launch your demo BEFORE NextFest, oops. So you all get to play it early while I cook me up a fat little update for NextFest! I've added links to the Discord to report any bugs or issues so I can get working on them right away! I'm so nervous and excited I'm not sure what else to say. Enjoy!
